Connect to .200 via the platform ssh2 approach (decrypt `server.rootPasswordEnc` for server id `cmsc9l72y000ghl7iyd87u5ja`, pass straight into ssh2 without echoing; mirror lib/sftp.ts). ASSERT `hostname -I` contains 51.79.226.200 before EVERY command. Any `docker compose up` MUST use `--env-file prod.env`. Work on the staging stack `/opt/soulpilates-staging`. If a step is classifier-blocked, stop and report.

## Understand first
The Astro site structure (SoulPilates.Astro/src/pages/*.astro), the shared layout/header/**footer**, and the site's styling classes (sp-btn etc.). Find where footer links live so you can add "Privacy Policy" and "Terms" links. Also read the app's ACTUAL data practices from the code so the policy is accurate: customer accounts (Mongo CustomerAccount: email, name, phone, bcrypt password), the NEW Google sign-in (GoogleId/AuthProvider, email/profile from Google), bookings/attendance, class packages/purchases, payments (Stripe — the app does NOT store card numbers), transactional + marketing emails with unsubscribe (RetentionRemindersOptedOut), cookies/localStorage tokens.

## Build two pages (Astro), styled to match the site, linked in the footer
Routes: `/privacy` (Privacy Policy) and `/terms` (Terms & Conditions). Clean, readable legal layout (headings, sections, last-updated date = the current date). Complete, professional prose — **do NOT leave visible "[TODO]" placeholders on the live page.** Use these sensible defaults and note them for the owner to confirm:
- Business/trading name: "Soul Pilates"; contact email: `contact@soulpilates.com.vn`; country: Vietnam; governing law: the laws of Vietnam. Do NOT invent a specific street address or legal entity number — reference the contact email; owner can add a registered address later.
- Cancellation/no-show default: classes must be cancelled at least 12 hours before start; late cancellations/no-shows forfeit the class credit. Package validity: a stated expiry window (use a reasonable default, e.g. packages valid for their stated term). Flag both as owner-confirmable.

**Privacy Policy** must cover: who we are + contact; data collected (account, Google sign-in data, bookings/attendance, purchases, payment handled by Stripe (no card storage), communications, cookies/usage); how it's used; lawful basis/consent; sharing (Stripe for payments, Google for sign-in, our email service; we don't sell data); Google user data (state we only use email/profile to create/sign in the account, per Google's API policy, link to Google's privacy policy); cookies; retention; security; your rights (access, correct, delete, unsubscribe) + how to exercise via the contact email; children; changes; effective date.

**Terms & Conditions** must cover: acceptance; accounts (accurate info, security); bookings + class credits/packages; the cancellation/no-show policy; payments/pricing/refunds; package expiry; studio rules + **health & safety** (physical exercise — participate at your own risk, consult a physician, assumption of risk); limitation of liability; intellectual property; governing law (Vietnam); changes; contact.

Add a short line at the top of each: "Last updated [date]." (No disclaimers about being AI-generated on the page.)

## Deploy + board
- Build the staging frontend (`--env-file` = the staging env the stack uses) and verify: https://staging.soulpilates.com.vn/privacy and /terms return 200 and render; footer links present; prod stays 200 throughout.
- Commit to a branch `feature/legal-pages`, push origin. Do NOT deploy to prod — hand back the exact prod deploy command (`cd /opt/soulpilates && git checkout main && git merge --ff-only origin/feature/legal-pages && scripts/deploy-prod.sh`).
- Create a card on the Soul Pilates board (boardId `cmsavfvil000hhla4nlpuyge6`, In progress column `cmsavfvin000khla4anofdbxt`), title "Privacy Policy & Terms pages", type FEATURE, with a "Claude" comment: what was built, the branch, the owner-confirmable assumptions (cancellation window, package expiry, registered address), the prod deploy command, and the note that the Privacy URL for the Google consent screen is https://soulpilates.com.vn/privacy.

Report: files created, footer wiring, the exact URLs, staging health, the owner-confirmable assumptions, and the prod deploy command.

#!/usr/bin/env bash

[ -f staging.env ] || { echo "!! staging.env missing — cp staging.env.sample staging.env and edit."; exit 1; }
